hints.tr: `CREATE TABLE ad (sütun TİP kurallar, ...);` — her sütun bir satır, aralarında virgül.
hints.en: `CREATE TABLE name (column TYPE rules, ...);` — one column per line, commas in between.

hints.tr: Birincil anahtar olan sütun zaten boş kalamıyor; ona ayrıca `NOT NULL` yazman gerekmiyor. Diğer ikisine gerekiyor.
hints.en: A primary key column can never be empty anyway, so it needs no separate `NOT NULL`. The other two do.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE TABLE warehouses (
    code NVARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    city NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    capacity INT NOT NULL
);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE TABLE warehouses (
    code NVARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY,
    city NVARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    capacity INT NOT NULL
);
```

checks.query: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'warehouses' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;

SELECT k.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS c JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = c.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE c.TABLE_NAME = 'warehouses' AND c.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY';
